knowledge:
- key_parameters: mad_detected=Used in cellQC to set the threshold for filtering cells based on median absolute deviations of detected genes ;; G=Used in geneCluster to specify the range of mixture components to evaluate for Gaussian Mixture modeling ;; method=Used in geneCluster to choose between "gaussian" (default) and "hierarchical" clustering ;; model=Used in fusedLasso to specify the likelihood model, typically "binomial" ;; niter=Number of iterations in fusedLasso; setting niter > 1 allows consensus partitioning via consensusPart ;; ncores=Number of CPU cores to use for parallelization in fusedLasso ;; threshold=A vector of penalty thresholds used in wilcoxExt to determine cell type partitions ;; DAItest=Logical in allelicRatio indicating whether to perform a likelihood ratio test for dynamic allelic imbalance ;; order_by_group=Logical in makeHeatmap to control whether cells are ordered by their partition groups
- alternatives: wilcoxExt is a nonparametric alternative to fusedLasso, preferred when allelic counts deviate strongly from a binomial distribution (e.g., large over-dispersion or small theta) ;; hierarchical clustering is an alternative to Gaussian Mixture modeling in geneCluster, though GMM is generally preferred for single-cell allelic data
- when_to_use: Use when you have single-cell RNA-seq data with allelic counts (effect and non-effect alleles) and pre-defined cell types/states, and you want to identify genes with differential cell-type-specific allelic imbalance and group cell types with similar allelic ratios.
- pitfalls: Do not run the partitioning steps on gene clusters where the maximum difference in weighted mean allelic ratios across cell types is very small (e.g., <= 0.05), as this lacks statistical power and wastes computation time ;; Ensure that cell type labels (sce$x) were determined using total counts or prior knowledge, and not using allelic ratios, to avoid circular reasoning ;; Preprocessing adds a pseudo-count for visualization and clustering, but original counts must be used for downstream statistical inference.

workflows.name: allelic_imbalance_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify genes with differential cell-type-specific allelic imbalance and partition cell types by their allelic ratios using single-cell allelic counts.
input: sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing discrete cell types in colData(sce)$x and allelic counts in assays "a1" and "a2")
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess the data to calculate allelic ratios and add pseudo-counts ;; 2. Perform cell-level quality control ;; 3. Perform gene-level quality control ;; 4. Cluster genes by their allelic imbalance profiles ;; 5. Summarize allelic ratios and check for sufficient variation ;; 6. Estimate over-dispersion to guide model selection ;; 7. Partition cell types using fused lasso or Wilcoxon extension ;; 8. Compute consensus partition if multiple iterations were run ;; 9. Estimate posterior allelic ratios and test for dynamic allelic imbalance ;; 10. Extract results and visualize using forest, step, violin, or heatmap plots
workflows.code:
library(airpart)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SingleCellExperiment))
p.vec <- rep(c(0.2, 0.8, 0.5, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9), each = 2)
set.seed(2021)
sce <- makeSimulatedData(
  mu1 = 2, mu2 = 10, nct = 4, n = 20,
  ngenecl = 25, theta = 20, ncl = 3,
  p.vec = p.vec
)
sce <- preprocess(sce)
makeHeatmap(sce)
cellQCmetrics <- cellQC(sce, mad_detected = 4)
keep_cell <- (
  cellQCmetrics$filter_sum |
    cellQCmetrics$filter_detected |
    cellQCmetrics$filter_spike
)
sce <- sce[, keep_cell]
featureQCmetric <- featureQC(sce)
keep_feature <- (featureQCmetric$filter_celltype &
  featureQCmetric$filter_sd &
  featureQCmetric$filter_spike)
sce <- sce[keep_feature, ]
sce <- geneCluster(sce, G = 1:4)
summary <- summaryAllelicRatio(sce)
sapply(1:length(summary), function(i) {
  inst <- summary[[i]]
  inst_order <- inst[order(inst$weighted.mean), ]
  max(diff(inst_order$weighted.mean)) > 0.05
})
estDisp(sce, genecluster = 1)
sce_sub <- fusedLasso(sce,
  model = "binomial",
  genecluster = 1, ncores = 1,
  niter = 2
)
sce_sub <- consensusPart(sce_sub)
thrs <- 10^seq(from = -2, to = -0.4, by = 0.2)
sce_sub_w <- wilcoxExt(sce, genecluster = 1, threshold = thrs)
sce_sub <- allelicRatio(sce_sub, DAItest = TRUE)
makeForest(sce_sub, showtext = TRUE)
genepoi <- paste0("gene", seq_len(5))
ar <- extractResult(sce_sub)
makeStep(sce_sub[genepoi,])
s <- extractResult(sce_sub, "svalue")
apply(s[genepoi,], 2, function(s){s < 0.005})
adj.p <- mcols(sce_sub)$adj.p.value
adj.p < 0.05
makeViolin(sce_sub)
makeHeatmap(sce_sub)
makeHeatmap(sce_sub, order_by_group = FALSE)
